dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 11, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Pirates Take Down Brewers in Thrilling Fashion**

In a back-and-forth battle, the Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers 6-7 in the first game of the series. Esmerlyn Valdez put on a hitting clinic, going 3-for-4 with two home runs and six RBIs, including a grand slam in the 9th inning. Braxton Ashcraft earned the win, while Aaron Ashby took the loss. The Pirates' bullpen held off a late Brewers rally to secure the win.

In the second game of the series, the Pirates took down the Brewers again, this time by a score of 2-3. Esmerlyn Valdez stayed hot, going 1-for-4 with a home run and two RBIs. Bubba Chandler was impressive on the mound, striking out six over 4.2 innings. Yohan Ramírez earned the win, while Mason Montgomery closed out the game for the save.

**Angels, White Sox, and Giants Post Wins**

The Minnesota Twins took down the Los Angeles Angels 5-3, behind a strong outing from Joe Ryan. Royce Lewis went 2-for-4 with a home run and two RBIs. The Twins' bullpen held off a late Angels rally to secure the win.

The Chicago White Sox edged out the Oakland Athletics 1-0, behind a solid start from Gage Jump. Chase Meidroth went 2-for-3 with an RBI, while Erick Fedde earned the win.

The San Francisco Giants took down the Colorado Rockies 4-2, behind a strong outing from Tyler Mahle. Casey Schmitt went 1-for-4 with a home run and three RBIs, while Kyle Freeland struck out nine over six innings.

**Yankees, Red Sox, and Astros Post Wins**

The New York Yankees took down the Washington Nationals 4-2, behind a strong outing from Cam Schlittler. Trent Grisham went 2-for-4 with a home run and two RBIs, while Brent Headrick earned the win.

The Boston Red Sox shut out the New York Mets 4-0, behind a strong outing from Jovani Morán. Andruw Monasterio went 2-for-3 with a home run and two RBIs, while Masataka Yoshida homered for the Red Sox.

The Houston Astros took down the Texas Rangers 9-3, behind a strong outing from Peter Lambert. Ezequiel Duran went 2-for-4 with two home runs and three RBIs, while LaMonte Wade Jr. added two RBIs.
